isolation.rootfs: only inventoried SDK payload, read-only after separately reviewed assembly
isolation.work: new empty unique writable batch, no previous caches
isolation.identity: unprivileged isolated uid; no capabilities; no-new-privileges
isolation.host_requirement: native Linux AArch64; no cross/emulated fallback
isolation.adapter: not selected or executed; must enforce/read back limits before any tool step

environment.epoch_caveat: CaDiCaL date/uname and generator local-date calls may ignore epoch; preserve observed bytes

failure.first_failure: terminate entire isolated process group/cgroup; no next stage, retry, network or budget increase
failure.infrastructure_probe_error: stop; do not reinterpret as absent feature
failure.on_cancel_or_supervisor_loss: same termination and preservation; qualify independently before execution
failure.preserve: all partial inputs, sources, objects, logs and outputs; append terminal failure receipt

cleanup.after_failure: only stop/remove exact ephemeral execution instance after bind-mounted records are retained
cleanup.batch_data: retain entire resolved host_batch_directory until explicit cleanup approval
cleanup.later_cleanup: enumerate exact owned paths with types/digests; reject symlinks/outside root; delete only approved list

staging.prerequisite: C1 acceptance plus separate SDK assembly authorization
staging.sdk: no apt/dpkg scripts; reviewed data payload assembly and full inventory/link/permission reconciliation
staging.sources: copy five checked trees to /work/src/<id>; verify exact trees before transforms; never edit originals
staging.source_modes: retained files are quarantined 0600; only in future copies restore 0755 when archive original_mode has execute bits, otherwise 0644; directories 0755; never restore setuid/setgid bits
staging.source_links: preserve only archived verified internal symlinks; no host link resolution or new external targets
staging.dependency_freeze: after prefix outputs and manifest review, freeze/remount exact prefix/header/archive inputs read-only and recheck identities before main configuration
staging.write_rules: create exclusively; original source preimages retained; output paths checked beneath fresh work root
staging.step_log_directories: create exact per-step log directory before dispatch; refuse reuse

cvc5.application: check-cvc5-build-patch.apply_exact; no offset/fuzz; writable copy only

requires: all search/specs/CRT paths mapped to SDK inventory
pkgconf output retained in order including repeats; resolve every header/archive to inventory
probe-results.json digest plus cache/trace and compiler diagnostics
reject infrastructure/tool errors; a false capability alone does not justify ignoring errors
select exactly one recorded macro/flag branch; never default missing results to false
actual gmp.h/gmpxx.h and libgmp.a/libgmpxx.a bytes, generated inputs and config.log
compiler/ABI and archive-member review before Poly uses GMP
complete actual six-role header inventories and actual archive identities
static-closure-and-abi-reviewed record with exact Editline order
